info.title: World News API Universal API
info.description: Access World News API for real-time and historical news search, top headlines, front pages, source discovery, article extraction, and geolocation utilities.

get.description: Extracts a news article from a URL using World News API.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: When true, perform full article analysis during extraction.
